minutes.headline: ZBA unanimously granted a special permit for setback and height variances for a two-car garage at 1 Wallace Park
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard and unanimously approved Weston Baker's special permit application for an attached two-car garage with storage above at 1 Wallace Park, which required dimensional relief on side and rear setbacks and building height; no abutters objected or spoke at the public hearing. The board also marked the retirement of longtime member Jim Bezicausski, discussed the process for moving Tony Niccastro from an associate to a full board seat via the Select Board, and voted to name Patrick Callahan vice chairman before adjourning.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals unanimously granted setback and height variances for a two-car garage with storage above at 1 Wallace Park.
No abutters spoke for or against the project when the public hearing opened.
The board named Patrick Callahan vice chairman following the retirement of longtime member Jim Bezicausski.
Members discussed moving Tony Niccastro from an associate to a full board seat, a step that requires action by the Select Board rather than a ZBA vote.

why_it_matters: The variance lets construction sit closer to the side and rear property lines and taller than the standard limit allows, which can factor into how future setback or height requests nearby are decided.
A retirement and a pending associate-to-full-member move change who sits on the board that rules on zoning variance requests going forward.
